steps.what: Select research findings, limitations and audience requirements for communication
Draft an audience-specific explanation from the verified research packet

loop.purpose: Explain approved findings for the specified audience
loop.input: Verified findings, references, limitations and audience brief
loop.output: Draft with source links and uncertainty statements
loop.check: Epidemiologist checks every claim, denominator and caveat against the packet
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims revert to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific explanation requires language judgement rather than field substitution

steps.what: Approve the communication and communicate findings to practitioners, policy makers or public audiences

tasks.design: Use an approved drafting facility in {DOCS} for a source-linked explanation, after the epidemiologist selects the findings. The epidemiologist corrects the draft, approves its exact version and handles publication or live questions through {EMAIL} and meetings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Findings must be translated without losing uncertainty or population limits.
tasks.enabler_now: Research drafting capabilities exist, although this public-health communication design remains unmeasured.
tasks.still_hard: Avoid misleading causal language and inappropriate individual advice.
tasks.human_edge: Judge public meaning and answer consequential questions.

ambition.what: Prepare accessible versions for an additional audience, with separately budgeted review and delivery.

tasks.altitude: Own evidence quality and public interpretation.

evidence.claim: Benchling drafts study reports; this establishes research drafting capability, not safe public-health publication or measured savings here.
The proposed source-bound communication workflow and its time effect are unmeasured.

assumptions: The epidemiologist produces findings, denominators, population, dates, limitations, references and audience brief in s1; all selection and capture time is counted there.
Only permitted aggregate material enters the draft tool; missing references or unresolved disclosure questions require manual writing.
Use the existing document suite before adding an integration.
Draft claim checking is counted in s2; final approval and delivery in s3.
Five extra focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover template and source-policy upkeep.
unknowns: Proportion of communication time spent on drafts rather than discussion
research_questions: Does source verification leave any net saving across representative disease communications?

already_counted.description: Verified finding and audience packet preparation

approvals.approved_version: Exact text, figures, source packet, audience and destination; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91.25; gross 8.75 minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 3.75%. Conservative pilot range 0-2% allows more correction; live discussion retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Validate public health program records and define oversight measures
Calculate specified health program indicators and display incomplete records
Oversee program improvements and resolve statistical, surveillance and planning concerns

tasks.design: Configure oversight tables in {SPREADSHEET}, based on records and definitions checked by the epidemiologist. Keep statistical interpretation, planning and program changes with the epidemiologist and program team using {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program indicators may use different denominators and reporting periods.
tasks.enabler_now: A defined indicator calculation can run repeatedly in the existing workbook.
tasks.still_hard: Data completeness does not establish effectiveness or equitable coverage.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which program changes are justified.

ambition.what: Review a stable set of indicators more frequently without assuming additional surveillance data appear for free.

tasks.altitude: Own program outcomes and indicator validity.

evidence.claim: EIOS supports epidemic intelligence; it does not demonstrate automated program management or savings for this dashboard.
Configured indicator tables can remove repeated calculation after data validation.

assumptions: In s1 the epidemiologist captures or verifies program ID, reporting period, numerator, denominator, source, missingness and approved indicator formula; its 35 hours includes reconciliation with staff.
Program staff produce underlying service records through their existing work; any extra reconciliation is budgeted separately, not treated as a free new feed.
Missing or incomparable records stop the affected indicator and return it to human investigation.
Use native spreadsheet reporting before building a dashboard service.
Six extra focal hours and three other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover definition upkeep and source reconciliation.
research_questions: Does repeated calculation occupy enough current oversight time to repay validation and upkeep?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 6 upkeep gives central net 14%. Pilot range 0-4% discounts the unverified calculation share; existing automatic reporting yields zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Investigate diseases through evidence collection, hypothesis testing and causal interpretation
outputs: qualified findings on causes, risks and transmission

tasks.design: Keep investigation design, field evidence assessment and causal interpretation with the epidemiologist. Existing {DOCS} and {SPREADSHEET} support the work; no defined repeatable analysis package is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disease investigations involve incomplete evidence and changing hypotheses.
tasks.enabler_now: Evidence tools support investigation without establishing its conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Separate transmission pathways, confounding and reporting bias.
tasks.human_edge: Choose valid methods and judge competing explanations.
tasks.altitude: Own the validity and limits of disease investigations.

evidence.claim: EIOS provides epidemic intelligence, which is evidence support rather than an automatic determination of disease causation.

assumptions: No repetitive calculation phase is asserted without a defined study protocol and observed workload.
Existing document and analysis tools remain in use; no new automation upkeep is introduced.
Program indicator preparation is covered by the separate oversight task and is not counted again here.
research_questions: Which specific repeated calculations recur across observed investigations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Investigation and scientific judgement retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Educate healthcare workers, patients and public audiences about transmission and prevention

tasks.design: The epidemiologist teaches from approved materials in {DOCS} and responds to questions. This education task retains its delivery time; research communication drafting is accounted for separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: People differ in health literacy, concerns and practical constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Check understanding and distinguish general prevention from personal clinical advice.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching and respond to uncertainty and anxiety.
tasks.altitude: Own accessible and accurate disease education.

evidence.claim: Interactive disease education retains its human teaching and question-handling time in this design.

assumptions: The baseline covers educational delivery and adaptation rather than a second copy of research communication drafting.
Use existing approved materials; no new answer service, content maintenance or tool is proposed.
unknowns: Balance of group education and individual discussion
research_questions: Is there a distinct recurring preparation workload outside the research communication task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Teaching and questions retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own epidemiological evidence, program outcomes and trustworthy communication.
reach: Support public health analysts with defined indicators
Support health educators with accessible evidence explanations
role.ambitious_version: An epidemiologist who uses repeatable reporting and checked drafts while protecting investigation, program judgement and public trust.
